variants.title: Magnetic susceptibility of manganese sulphate by the Gouy balance
variants.unknown: the molar susceptibility of manganese sulphate
variants.note: Mn2+ has five unpaired electrons against one for Cu2+, so its susceptibility is about ten times larger and the pull is easy to see even at small fields. The packed density is a value of this filling.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, magnetic susceptibility of inorganic compounds: MnSO4.H2O about +14200e-6 cm^3/mol

variants.title: Magnetic susceptibility of ferrous sulphate by the Gouy balance
variants.unknown: the molar susceptibility of ferrous sulphate
variants.note: Fe2+ carries four unpaired electrons. The packed density is a value of this filling.

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, magnetic susceptibility of inorganic compounds: FeSO4.7H2O about +11200e-6 cm^3/mol
